items.heading: Moussaka
details: Key ingredients: eggplant, potato, minced lamb, tomato, bechamel sauce, cinnamon
Fry or roast sliced eggplant and potato until golden.
Cook minced lamb with tomato, onion and a touch of cinnamon.
Layer potato, eggplant and meat sauce in a baking dish, then top with bechamel.
Bake until the top is golden and set before slicing.

items.heading: Greek Salad
details: Key ingredients: tomato, cucumber, red onion, olives, feta cheese, olive oil, oregano
Chop tomato, cucumber and onion into large chunks.
Toss with olives and a generous slab of feta on top.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with dried oregano.
Serve immediately without refrigerating for the best flavor.

items.heading: Baklava
details: Key ingredients: phyllo pastry, chopped walnuts or pistachios, butter, honey syrup
Layer buttered phyllo sheets in a tray, sprinkling nuts between layers.
Cut into diamond shapes before baking until golden and crisp.
Bake until the top layers are deep golden brown.
Pour cooled honey syrup over the hot baklava and let it soak in.
